content.title: OFG Bancorp (OFG) Margin Expansion Reinforces Profitability Narrative Despite Slower Earnings Growth
content.summary: OFG Bancorp (OFG) reported a net profit margin of 31.4%, up from 29.9% a year ago, with five-year annualized earnings growth at 17.4%. However, year-over-year earnings growth slowed to just 1.3%, and future earnings are expected to rise at only 0.2% per year, trailing the US market's 15.5% rate.
